component.name: OpenSanctuary
component.summary: Church presentation software for lyrics, scripture and slides

description.p: OpenSanctuary runs a church service's screens: song lyrics, Bible passages, slides, images and video, with a live output for the projector, a stage display for musicians, and remotes and Android TV displays on the same network.

ul.li: Build a schedule from songs, scripture, presentations and media, and run it live
Import from EasyWorship, OpenLP, FreeShow, PowerPoint and OpenDocument
Animated and still backgrounds, themes and a slide editor
Sandboxed plugins for lyrics lookup, online Bibles, stock images and video import
